# Library/book_by_title

Show who wrote a book, and how many copies the library owns, given its title.

Source: `_commands/Library/book_by_title.py`.

Calls: `Library/find_book`, `Library/open_book`.
Depth: 1 (lower bound; open steps name no command)

## Inputs

| input | type | default | sample | classifier_confirms / classifier_decides | copied_from_command_text / record_named_in_command_text | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | str | required | `<title>` |  | yes | the book's title |

- `title` must be written in the command text (`copied_from_command_text`).

## Example requests

- who wrote Dune
- how many copies of Dune Messiah are there
- who is the author of Persuasion, and how many copies do we have
- tell me about the book Emma
- what is Dune Messiah by, and how many copies
- give me the author and copy count for the title Emma
